english.title: Cab owner fail to protect cab-driver licence from loss or damage / failed inform TFL of loss or damage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a cab-owner who had retained the licence of a cab-driver, namely **(..SPECIFY CAB-DRIVER..) in pursuance of section 21 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843,

(A)_[failed to preserve it undamaged and undefaced]_
(B)_[made a mark upon it otherwise than as provided in Section 8 of that Act]_
(C)_[failed, when the licence became defaced, to forthwith furnish to Transport for London as full a statement as was of the circumstances in which it was defaced]_
(D)_[failed, when the licence was lost, to forthwith furnish to Transport for London as full a statement as was of the circumstances in which it was lost]_
(E)_[failed, when the licence became defaced to send or deliver it to Transport for London at the same time]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 29(1) of the London Cab Order 1934 and section 10 of the Metropolitan Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cab owner retaining cab-driver's licence
failed to protect licence from loss or damage or being defaced
OR failed to provide statement to Transport for London as to circumstances lost, damaged or defaced
OR failed to send or deliver damaged or defaced licence to Transport for London.
